tagline: One always-current source of truth for the WiSE product marketing team
_note_teamsWebhook: Set teamsWebhookConfigured to true once your Codex agent is posting digest summaries to your Teams channel (see codex-templates/teams-notifier.md). The webhook URL itself lives in your Codex setup, never in this repo.

intelHub.label: WiSE Intel Hub
intelHub.note: The Intel tab reads this site's signals.json directly and renders every signal inside the hub's own layout — it is a data feed, not an embedded site. `url` locates the feed (url + 'signals.json') and powers the 'Source site' link; set `dataUrl` to override the feed location.
